title: Kaash tumko neend
body:
baba ki pyari sakina
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam e ghariban hai ye sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
be-sar padar ka ban mein tha nauha
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
<<DIVIDER>>
pathar badan se hataun to kaise
lori tumhe mai sunaun to kaise
pehlu mein soja ay shaahzadi
seene pe tum ko sulaun to kaise
teeron bhara hai bistar tumhara
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
baysheer wapas jo aaya nahi hai
maine tumhe ye bataya nahi hai
lori sunayi hai teeron ne usko
asghar ko maine sulaya nahi hai
tum ko to lori dete hai baba
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt mujhpe bhi mushkil badi thi
pehlu mein maadar ke sota tha mai bhi
mai jaanta hoon ye mushkil hai kitna
bichdi thi jab mujhse dadi tumhari
mere liye bhi kehti thi zehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
har taur khud ko sambhalegi zainab
go tum jo royi to royegi zainab
tum bhi samajhti ho phir bhi kahunga
gar tum na soyi to jaagegi zainab
zainab ki khaatir so jao beta
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo dekho kuch door soye hai akbar
aun o mohamed hai soye wahan par
aadat hai pehre mein sone ki tumko
bibi muhafiz hai poore bahattar
charon taraf hai laashon ka pehra
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek dher hai patharon ka zameen par
baithi ek bibi jis ke barabar
aulaad ke gham mein doobe padar ki
aati hai jis se sadayein ye akbar
jaagogi kab tak meri sakina
kaash tum ko neend aa jaaye
shaam e ghariban hai...
author: Hasnain Akbar
